correctness.rationale: For every full-dimensional lattice tetrahedron and integer m>=1, a direct open-parallelepiped inclusion-exclusion gives T_m=6am^3-4bm^2+Em-3; open-box involution and Ehrhart reciprocity give A_m=I_S(m) and gamma_m=T_m-4A_m=2am^3+(E-4c)m+1. In h* coordinates gamma_2=2E+4h2-11>=1 and gamma_m=1+(m/2)(gamma_2-1)+(H/3)(m^3-4m)>0 for m>=2. The quadratic root discriminant is gamma_m(4A_m+gamma_m), which is positive for A_m>0; the coefficient and root multiplicity conditions follow. The m=1,2,3,4 special cases use exact reciprocity; the unimodular tetrahedron attains sharp m=4. Twenty-eight independent complete finite box enumerations and exact symbolic identities corroborate the proof but are not substitutes for the infinite arguments.

originality.rationale: The closest two primary full texts were read: Borger-Kretschmer-Nill (2023) Proposition 4.5 supplies general dimensional-three local Ehrhart coefficient identities, but not the strictly positive gap and sharp complete dilation phase diagram; Nill (2026) Theorem 1.2 gives eventual real-rootedness only for sufficiently large lattice width with no sharp finite dilation constant. The present theorem extracts a universal arithmetic gap gamma2=2E+4h2-11 and proves the exact first-dilate criteria; these are not explicit statements of the prior theorems. Published mathematical-finding searches and actual historical claims offered no matching implication. The derivation nevertheless uses existing general machinery, so residual priority risk is stated.

value.rationale: A complete sharp root-multiplicity classification for every three-dimensional lattice simplex under every positive integral dilation resolves a natural quantitative version of eventual real-rootedness in the first four dilates. The universal onset m=4 is attained by the unimodular simplex, while the precise earlier thresholds are expressed by intrinsic Ehrhart coefficients; gamma2=2E+4h2-11 gives a dimension-specific geometric bridge from edge lengths to strict real-rootedness. This is not a single low-parameter census or unsupported numerical improvement; its relevance is the full natural class and exact optimal cutoff.
